triggers.name: ultrawork
triggers.inject: Ultrawork mode: maximize agent utilization and tool execution. Use subagents for exploration/analysis and verify results before answering.

triggers.name: search
triggers.inject: Search mode: widen coverage, use directory listing and file search tools, and delegate to subagents when exploration is heavy.

triggers.name: analyze
triggers.inject: Analyze mode: gather context before conclusions, validate assumptions, and use subagents for specialized reasoning if needed.
